section: Closing strips and fillers for Maxima and Intarsio
source_pages: printed p.434 / PDF 436 (subset extracted: the H.48 row of the third position)
family_note: No family-level keys - see fillers_h78.json. UNLOCKED 2026-08-23: this row waited only on its family, and printed p.214-216 supplied it the same day. It is the first of the 26 orphan filler codes to be retired, and the mechanism is exactly the one fillers_h78.json describes - a filler may not be extracted before its family exists, so extracting a family retires its fillers.

filler_wall_unit.description: Wall unit filler in door finishes from 2,3 to 15 cm - with one-piece bottom

front_layout.note: One finished front covering the whole face. NO hinge_axis and no mechanism - a filler does not open. Stated rather than left absent because Panel.effective_slabs and Panel.gola_options both default a missing layout to 'single', and a default is not a source.

filler_wall_unit.notes: PC = H.48, and the order of arrival is worth keeping: the FILLER table named this letter before any wall page we held could have, exactly as factory estimate 2026/30829 named PD before printed p.221 was opened. Two independent sources, one letter, twice.
